rules.statement: For a library hosted in a public GitHub repository, enable SourceLink with the `Microsoft.SourceLink.GitHub` package and `PublishRepositoryUrl=true`, and do not set `EmbedAllSources`, so tracked source isn't embedded in the PDB.
rules.why: The public repo serves tracked source from raw.githubusercontent.com with no auth, so a debugger can fetch it. Embedding all sources would only make every package bigger.
rules.check: Look for MSBuild changes that remove the Microsoft.SourceLink.GitHub reference or PublishRepositoryUrl from packable projects, or that add `EmbedAllSources=true` in a public-repo build.

rules.statement: Set `EmbedUntrackedSources=true` on packable projects so that generated files with no source-control URL (for example Nerdbank.GitVersioning `ThisAssembly`/`AssemblyInfo`) are embedded in the PDB.
rules.why: Untracked generated files have no URL to point at, so embedding them is the only way step-into debugging works for them.
rules.check: Look for packable build configuration that drops `EmbedUntrackedSources` or sets it to false.

rules.statement: Packable projects must use `DebugType=portable` with `IncludeSymbols=true` and `SymbolPackageFormat=snupkg`, so each `.nupkg` ships with a companion `.snupkg`.
rules.why: The `.snupkg` can be published to the NuGet.org symbol server, which gives consumers the standard symbol story while keeping the main package small.
rules.check: Look for changes to DebugType (such as embedded, full or none), removal of IncludeSymbols, or a SymbolPackageFormat other than snupkg on packable projects.

rules.statement: Set `ContinuousIntegrationBuild=true` when building on CI, so package output is deterministic and has normalized paths.
rules.why: Deterministic, path-normalized builds let consumers trust that a package was built from a known commit.
rules.check: Look for removal of ContinuousIntegrationBuild, or of the condition that sets it on CI, in the shared build props/targets.

rules.statement: Package publishing pipelines must push the `.snupkg` symbol package along with each `.nupkg`.
rules.why: Without the symbol package on the symbol server, consumers can't step into the released source.
rules.check: Look for CI/release workflow changes that push only `*.nupkg` and leave out the `*.snupkg` artifacts.
